Date. 15 / 2 / 33

Memorandum on Dr. Reifler

Dr. Reifler, Austrian, is believed to have arrived
in Shanghai from Berlin during the early part of 1932. He
resided at No.1363 Rue Lafayette (Clements Apartments)
from April 5 to June 1, when he removed to 217 Avenue du
Roi Albert. For a time he dwelt at No.1331 Rue Lafayette
(Blackstone Apartments). He is now understood to be
residing at No.491 Rue Lafayette.

Upon arrival here Reifler is reported to have stated
that he was a representative of the "Nachrichten Agentur"
(Information Agency), Berlin and that his object in
coming to Shanghai was to collect information on the
economic situation in China. The above mentioned Agency,
it is reported, was nothing but a branch of the "Chung
Hwa News Agency". Reifler's connection with the above two
agencies could not, however, be confirmed.

According to French Police information Reifler was
in close touch with E. Kisch (File D.2919) during the
latter's stay-in Shanghai and it was believed that the two
met in the house of Dr. Bume (File D.2919) at 161 Route
Mayen.

Prior to coming to Shanghai Reifler is reported as
having made an extensive study of Oriental languages,
especially Chinese, first in Vienna and afterwards in
Berlin. While in Berlin he is understood to have
acted as correspondent for the Neue Frei Presse, a
democratic newspaper published in Vienna.

On Oct.21, 1932 a note appeared in the "Deutsche
Shanghai Zeitung" to the effect that Dr. Reifler had been
appointed Professor of German at the Zikawei University,
Avenue Haig. According to this newspaper, Dr. Reifler is a
capable Chinese scholar.

关于赖夫勒博士（Dr. Reifler）的备忘录

赖夫勒博士，奥地利人，据信于1932年初从柏林抵达上海。他于4月5日至6月1日期间居住在拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）1363号（克莱门茨公寓，Clements Apartments），随后搬至阿尔伯特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）217号。他曾一度居住在拉斐特路1331号（布莱克斯通公寓，Blackstone Apartments）。据悉，他目前居住在拉斐特路491号。

据报，赖夫勒抵沪后声称自己是柏林“Nachrichten Agentur”（通讯社）的代表，其来沪目的是收集有关中国经济状况的情报。据报道，上述通讯社不过是“中华新闻社”（Chung Hwa News Agency）的一个分支。然而，赖夫勒与上述两家机构的关联未能得到证实。

根据法国警方情报，赖夫勒在基施（E. Kisch，档案号 D.2919）驻留上海期间与其保持密切联系，据信两人曾在迈恩路（Route Mayen）161号布姆博士（Dr. Bume，档案号 D.2919）的寓所会面。

据报，在来上海之前，赖夫勒曾广泛研究东方语言，特别是中文，先是在维也纳，后来在柏林。据悉，他在柏林期间曾担任维也纳出版的民主报纸《新自由报》（Neue Frei Presse）的通讯员。

1932年10月21日，《德文上海报》（Deutsche Shanghai Zeitung）刊登了一则消息，称赖夫勒博士已被任命为海格路（Avenue Haig）徐家汇大学（Zikawei University）的德语教授。据该报称，赖夫勒博士是一位精通中文的学者。

Made by D.3.Prokofiev. Forwarded by （签名）

Enquiries made with a view to discovering the political
opinions held by Dr. Reifler who forms the subject of the at-
tached memorandum ( File D. 3854 ), show that he is reputed to be
a left-wing socialist without, however, possessing communistic
tendencies.

It reported that Reifler is of middle age and that prior
to coming to Shanghai he made an extensive study of oriental
languages, especially of Chinese, first in Vienna and later in
Berlin. It is also reported that while in Berlin he acted as a
correspondent of the " Neue Freie Presse"- a democratic newspaper
published in Vienna.

It is rumoured that while in Shanghai he maintained
secret contact with a certain foreigner employed as an advisor
with the Nanking Government. After this fact had become known
this contact was discontinued and Reifler was given the post of
Professor of German at Chiao Tung University, No 1954 Avenue Haig
( formerly known as Nanyang College). Enquiries, however, have so
far, failed to verify this rumour.

据报，赖夫勒系中年人，在来上海之前，他先在维也纳，后在柏林，对东方语言，特别是中文，进行了广泛的研究。另据报，他在柏林期间曾担任维也纳出版的民主报纸《新自由报》（Neue Freie Presse）的通讯员。

有谣言称，他在上海期间与某位受聘为南京政府顾问的外国人保持秘密联系。此事曝光后，该联系中断，赖夫勒获任海格路1954号交通大学（前身为南洋公学）德语教授一职。然而，迄今进行的查询未能证实这一谣言。

However, from enquiries made and from examination of the documents
seized it appears that the prisoners' statements are, probably, false.
This will be seen from the following circumstances:-

1/. The organizers of the meeting took advantage of the fact that a
regularly convened meeting had just been concluded at the Y.M.C.A.
building, in order to hold therein their own meeting without the
knowledge of the persons responsible for the said building, and that
all the prisoners are unwilling to give the reason for changing
the place of the meeting.

2/. Certain accused represented several organizations and they refus-
ed to disclose what these organizations were.

3/. The proposals made by representatives of the abovementioned orga-
nizations concern the carrying out of communist propaganda during
the month of May ( vide the documentary evidence).

4/. The notification published in the newspapers on the subject of
the meeting was only published with a view to deceiving the Autho-
rities charged with the maintenance of public order by making them
believe that the meeting was of a purely patriotic character.

5/. The accused ,at the time the police entered into the hall where
the meeting was being held, tried to destroy papers bearing notes
relating to proposals made and decisions taken during the meeting
and that an examination of the re-assembled pieces of paper pro-
ved the communist character of the meeting. For instance:-

Proposal made by Siau Sze Tse and Ho Teh Foo, Approval
of the minutes of the meeting held by the Federation of the Uni-
versities and Secondary Schools in Shanghai ( Exhibit 4 ).

6/. The majority of the accused gave false addresses in order to
prevent the police from searching their residences where, pro-
bably, evidence might have been found proving their guilt.

C. 抗议和平会议等等。

然而，从调查及对查获文件的审查来看，囚犯的供词可能是虚假的。这可以从以下情况看出：-

1/. 会议组织者利用青年会大楼刚刚结束一次常规召集的会议之机，在该大楼内未经负责人知晓的情况下举行了自己的会议，且所有囚犯均不愿透露更改会议地点的原因。

2/. 某些被告代表多个组织，他们拒绝披露这些组织是什么。

3/. 上述组织代表提出的提案涉及在五月份进行共产主义宣传（见书面证据）。

4/. 报纸上发布的关于该会议的通知仅是为了欺骗负责维持公共秩序的当局，使其相信该会议具有纯粹的爱国性质。

5/. 当警察进入举行会议的大厅时，被告试图销毁载有关于会议期间提出的提案和作出的决定的笔记的纸张，对重新拼凑的纸片的检查证明了会议的共产主义性质。例如：-

萧思之和贺德府提出的提案，批准上海各大学及中学联合会会议记录（证物4）。

6/. 大多数被告提供虚假地址，以防止警察搜查其住所，因为在那里可能会找到证明其有罪的证据。

October 22, 1928.

We learn that the "Chung Hwa News Agency"
(Chinese Information Agency), of which the central office
has been established at No. 33 Rue Amiral Courbet, Shanghai,
is a propaganda agency of the Left Wing of the Kuomintang.
Its leaders are closely connected with Wang Ching Wei (汪精衛),
Zeng Kong Po (陳公博 ), Tsang Fah Kwei (張發奎 ) and other
leaders of this political group. The European office
of this agency is in Berlin (5 Witzlebenplatz). The
agency has established six branches - in Canton, Tientsin,
Paris, Geneve, New York and Montreal (Canada). The
agency was established in 1926 in Berlin and Canton under
the name of "PRODEHENER NEWS AGENCY" (Propaganda Dept. of
the Nationalist Army Headquarters).

The manager of the Shanghai office is a certain
MEI SU TSENG ( ), former student of the Nationalist
University at Peking, where he studied in 1919-21 under
the direction of the German professor, Dr. Wilhelm (at
present Director of the Oriental Institute at Frankfurt
on Main). He then went to Germany where he studied
political economy during the period 1921-26. Having
organized the bureau of the "News Agency" in Berlin in
1926, he proceeded to Canton where he was appointed by
Tsiang Kia Zah (? Chiang Kai Shek) as Chief of the Propaganda
Department of the Nationalist Army.

The "Chung Hwa News Agency" is governed by a
council consisting of the following members:-
MEI SU TSENG( ), QUO TAI CHI(郭泰祺 . former
Commissioner for Foreign Affairs, Kiangsu Province),
DR. CHU CHIA HWA (朱家驊 ), Professor of the Su YatSen's
University at Canton, ZIA CHI FANG( ), HSIANG KWANG
ZENG(. ), former representative of the Nationalist

1928年10月22日。

据悉，“中华新闻社”（Chinese Information Agency）总办事处设于上海高乃依路（Rue Amiral Courbet）33号，系国民党左派的宣传机构。其领导人与汪精卫、陈公博、张发奎及其他该政治集团领导人关系密切。该社欧洲办事处位于柏林（Witzlebenplatz 5号）。该社设有六个分社——分别位于广州、天津、巴黎、日内瓦、纽约和蒙特利尔（加拿大）。该社于1926年在柏林和广州成立，当时名为“PRODEHENER NEWS AGENCY”（国民革命军总司令部宣传部）。

上海办事处经理为梅苏曾（MEI SU TSENG，音译），系前北京国立大学学生，1919年至1921年间在该校受德国教授威廉博士（Dr. Wilhelm，现任美因河畔法兰克福东方研究所所长）指导学习。随后他前往德国，于1921年至1926年间攻读政治经济学。1926年在柏林组建“新闻社”办事处后，他前往广州，被蒋介石（Tsiang Kia Zah，疑为Chiang Kai Shek之误）任命为国民革命军宣传部主任。

“中华新闻社”由理事会管理，成员如下：梅苏曾（MEI SU TSENG，音译）、郭泰祺（QUO TAI CHI，前江苏省外交特派员）、朱家骅博士（DR. CHU CHIA HWA，广州中山大学教授）、夏奇方（ZIA CHI FANG，音译）、项光增（HSIANG KWANG ZENG，音译，前驻布鲁塞尔国民政府代表）以及记者、中央情报局局长董显华（G. H. TUNG）。

Government in Brussels and G. H. TUNG, journalist, director
of the central bureau of information.
The principal objects of this agency are :-
Rapprochement between China and foreign countries, and
furnishing the masses with information regarding the
foreign, economic and social policy of the Kuomintang.
At the same time, the agency carries out active
propaganda work in favour of the abolition of unequal
treaties, withdrawal from China of foreign troops and the
rendition of concessions.
MEI SU TUNG, in the course of a private conversation,
expressed his views on the present political situation.
The following is a summary of his views:- "The Nationalist
Government, said he, is unable to accomplish its heavy task
without the active support of the left wing of the Kuomintang.
This is the only group which has any intention of solving
the peasants' problem--the most important problem of the
present policy in China in accordance with the principles
of the late Sun Yat-Sen. The right wing of the Kuomintang
has done nothing in this direction; that is why the
sympathies of the peasant masses are with communism."
"However, the struggle between the right and left wings
of the Kuomintang will be of a purely parliamentary character.
It will never be transformed into a civil war, because the
junior officers, non-commissioned officers and soldiers
which were recruited among students are against another civil
war. These elements are under the influence of the left
wing of the Kuomintang and are ardent adepts of the Sun
Yat Sen's Three Principles. They have a firm control
over the majority of the soldiers, while the generals
have very little influence over the latter. A civil war
would have broken out two months ago, if it were not stopped
by the influence of these elements, to the great displeasure
of the generals."

(2)

该社主要宗旨为：促进中国与外国之间的亲善，并向民众提供有关国民党对外、经济和社会政策的信息。同时，该社积极开展宣传工作，主张废除不平等条约、外国军队撤出中国以及归还租界。

梅苏东（MEI SU TUNG，音译，应指梅苏曾）在一次私人谈话中表达了他对当前政治局势的看法。其观点摘要如下：“他说，‘如果没有国民党左派的积极支持，国民政府无法完成其艰巨任务。这是唯一有意根据已故孙中山先生的原则解决农民问题——即当前中国政策中最重要问题——的团体。国民党右派在此方向上无所作为；这就是为什么广大农民群众同情共产主义的原因。’”

“然而，国民党左右两派之间的斗争将纯粹具有议会性质。它永远不会演变为内战，因为从学生中招募的下级军官、士官和士兵反对再次发生内战。这些人员受国民党左派影响，是孙中山三民主义的热烈拥护者。他们牢牢控制着大多数士兵，而将军们对士兵的影响甚微。如果不是受到这些人员的阻挠，内战早在两个月前就会爆发，这令将军们极为不满。”

据悉，“中华新闻社”（见我方先前报告）正处于清算状态，在上海已停止运作。该社办事处所在的高乃依路33号房屋已出租给他人。该社社长梅苏曾的妻子已于本月26日离开上海前往北平。
